subject: website
name: API3 DAO
summary: The API3 DAO staking and voting dashboard. Its source is public (no licence file). It is not Level 3: when it opens, its wallet library loads WalletConnect's hidden verify frame, third-party code the user has not asked for. It also embeds a YouTube video and loads Google Fonts.

connections.name: WalletConnect verify frame and wallet list
connections.note: Loaded when the page opens, before any wallet is connected.

connections.name: YouTube embed (youtube-nocookie.com)
connections.note: A visible player on the page.

connections.name: Google Fonts
connections.note: Fetched when the page opens; tells Google the visit.
